sources.title: Avernic — War Dragons Help Center
sources.snippet: The curious draught opened something in Avernic, unstitching bone and sinew and leaving a maw of flaming green aether in its torso. Out of this strange portal clawed half-remembered specters and formless entities, desperate to escape the sweltering realm within Avernic.
